description: This file defines an Android Fragment subclass called LogFragment, which manages a custom LogView component inside a ScrollView. It provides methods to create and initialize the view hierarchy, including setting layout parameters, styling, and a listener to scroll to the bottom when text changes. The fragment is intended to display log data received via the LogNode interface, though the interface implementation is not shown here.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that contains a LogView inside a ScrollView, managing log display and user interaction to scroll the log view appropriately.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the view hierarchy, initializing the ScrollView and LogView with layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overridden method to set up the view when Fragment loads, including a TextWatcher to scroll to the bottom when log text changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
